bear_assumptions: Approximately 8x full-year non-GAAP EPS guidance if margin contraction persists and branded checkout, transaction-margin growth, or active accounts weaken.
base_assumptions: Approximately 12x full-year non-GAAP EPS guidance if raised guidance is delivered but durable margin and active-account acceleration remain unproven.
bull_assumptions: Approximately 15x full-year non-GAAP EPS guidance if branded checkout stabilizes, Venmo monetization improves, and transaction-margin and operating-margin growth recover.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only after fresh evidence supports durable transaction-margin and operating-margin recovery, active-account or branded-checkout improvement, favorable scenario asymmetry and an accepted current causal relationship; downgrade if checkout, margins, accounts, credit, regulation, or free cash flow deteriorate.
